programs.name: anonym.to (privacy proxy)
programs.notes: Seeded from yocreoquesi/caps-spec:wrappers.json#anonymto. Naked-query privacy proxy: destination travels directly after `?` with no parameter key. The `param` field is informational only for network-redirect (SPEC §5.1).

programs.name: Impact Radius
programs.notes: Seeded from yocreoquesi/caps-spec:wrappers.json#impact. Impact assigns brand-specific subdomains (gohealth.pxf.io, target.pxf.io, ...). The apex pxf.io is recorded here; CAPS's exact-host matching does not catch subdomains — adopters that need broader coverage should match by `*.pxf.io` suffix in their own code until a future schema bump introduces wildcard domain entries.
